name: clearly
description: Give your agent your company's documents. The workspace mounts as a FILESYSTEM — ls, grep, read, edit, write over every document — where every change carries a commit message and is revertable, and `document-status` tells the agent what the HUMAN changed since it last looked, so it re-reads instead of answering from a stale body. Plus a company brain (search org context and write decisions back so they compound), a spatial Skia canvas to land diffs, diagrams and codebase maps as editable nodes, and real vector work: VECTORIZE a raster (PNG/JPG → clean editable SVG) and EXPORT any composition to print-ready SVG/PDF. Bundles DESIGN skills (design-craft, brand-identity, layout-systems) that give the agent studio-grade craft — grid construction, modular type scale, colour systems, optical correction and a verify-before-done pass — plus docs skills (clearly-docs), company-brain usage (clearly-workflows), canvas skills (clearly-canvas, pair-on-canvas, ship-review, visualize, codebase-map, sticker-pack) and setup (clearly-init).
